subject: computer keyboard
title: What If You Never Cleaned Your Keyboard?

scenes.text: What if you never cleaned your keyboard? One got taken away as a health hazard.
Every time you eat at your desk, crumbs fall between the keys and feed bacteria.
In 2008, a microbiologist swabbed 33 keyboards in one London office.
Several carried E. coli and staph. Four were judged possible health hazards.
One had five times more germs than a toilet seat, and 150 times the accepted limit. It was removed.
The twist: the toilet seat was cleaner because people actually clean it. One in nine never clean their keyboard.

description:
What if you never cleaned your keyboard? In a 2008 study for Which?, a microbiologist swabbed 33 office keyboards; some carried E. coli and Staphylococcus aureus, four were judged potential health hazards, and one with five times more germs than a toilet seat was removed.
The accompanying survey found 11% of people never clean their keyboard.
